# GuideLink v0.1.5

GuideLink now places channels matched only through the selected programme guide
in the managed **Other** group. The included Sky UK alias dataset also recognises
additional verified seasonal names and rebrands.

## Guide-only channel grouping

- Use **Other** for confirmed EPG-only fallback matches. Previously, a missing
  source category left the channel in its provider group, which could keep an
  otherwise unused group enabled. BBC Red Button 1 is one example.
- Use the existing group planning, channel-write, quarantine and recovery flow.
  Eligible provider groups are disabled only after those stages succeed and
  when the profile's provider-group cleanup option is enabled.
- Respect managed-group opt-out and preservation rules. Native-source channels
  with empty categories retain their existing groups.
- Keep matching safeguards unchanged. Other numbered Red Button feeds still
  need their own source or guide identity; they are not mapped to feed 1.

## Sky UK aliases

Bundle revision 3 adds verified cinema seasonal identities, the Nick
Alvinnn!!! / Nick SpongeBob relationship, and New Vision TV / ARY World names.
Named guide targets are still validated; a reused channel number alone does not
establish service continuity. Matching thresholds are unchanged.

**An enabled alias set must also be selected in the profile.** In **Data → Alias
Sets**, choose the included **Sky UK channel aliases** dataset and a compatible
guide. Then select that set in **Data → Profiles → Channel handling →
Channel-name alias sets**. Updating the plugin does not automatically select a
set or change existing profile selections.

## Upgrade

Install `guidelink.zip` through m3u-editor's reviewed plugin update flow. Pause
GuideLink triggers and let active runs finish, approve and trust the update,
then recycle Horizon and reload web PHP workers where OPcache requires it.
Follow the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/djrarky/GuideLink/blob/v0.1.5/docs/INSTALL.md#update-an-existing-install).

Profiles, assignments and custom aliases are preserved. No database schema or
settings migration is required. Run **Preview Sync** before **Run Sync** to
review alias matches and group changes. Known-dead streams remain subject to
the existing health-aware recovery policy.

Download `guidelink.zip` for installation. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the assets and
`release.json` records the packaged file hashes.

## Validation

The grouping and alias changes passed focused regression tests and a reviewed
installation on an existing host. Preview, applying sync and a repeat preview
confirmed the intended group cleanup and stable channel metadata.

Release validation on host commit `7943b2171` (m3u-editor 0.13.6 with the plugin
UI patch), PHP 8.4:

- Full suite: **260 tests / 1,798 assertions** on SQLite and **260 tests / 1,796
  assertions** on PostgreSQL 16.
- All 115 PHP files passed syntax and formatting checks. Standalone plugin
  validation and all nine release-tool tests passed.
- The packaged archive passed native reviewed installation, trust, integrity
  verification and registry health checks in an isolated host. Installation
  testing used the host's fake scanner.

Tests cover EPG-only grouping, preservation/opt-out rules, seasonal identities,
stale saved mappings and separate numbered Red Button feeds. Automated
profile-form checks exercise the host UI through Livewire;
fresh manual browser first-run checks have not been performed for this patch.

Tests use isolated databases and synthetic streams. They do not constitute a
fresh provider playback scan or production load benchmark.
